summary.text: Dan Thomas is the Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 27B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jeffrie Long Jr. (D).
Ballotpedia lists service in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1984 to 2013, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a veteran of the Iraq War.

paragraphs.text: Dan Thomas earned a high school diploma from West Geauga High School and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1984 to 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a veteran of the Iraq War and a conservative who says he has served his country and community for nearly 30 years.
Thomas was unopposed in the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

He lists three campaign messages in his survey: relief from rising taxes and fees, lower energy bills, and fiscal responsibility, including opposition to a state grant for a project at National Harbor.
